purpose: Attribute hardware work in the existing scalar construction-cost investigation, preserving all earlier adverse costs and the rejected cache-free native gate.
trigger: Two full-cache construction phases had approximately 1.65x elapsed cost despite equal public arithmetic counts and no direct cache activity in the later scoped diagnostic.
libraries: Reuse the unchanged main, full-cache and no-persistent release libraries already linked by the original construction-trace-v1 protocol. No library rebuild, runtime source edit or native gate rerun.
source_change: Only a standalone observation wrapper and its C/Rust per-thread hardware counter backend. The complete original inputs/expected/witness/main suffix is copied byte-for-byte.
fixed_fixture: 4096 inputs, eight existing quadratic families, construction/first/warm/cloned phases in their original order; 32 work windows and 32 separate empty windows per process.
qualification: Standalone control and probe Clippy -D warnings
Control: two descriptors owned and closed, busy loop retires more instructions and cycles, disabled state stays disabled after normal return and unwind, unavailable counters preserve the body result
sample_policy: Exactly 18 fresh processes, six per variant; each variant occupies each position twice. All builds and controls finish before sampling. No replacement, extension, filtering or pooling with prior samples.
counter_policy: Current-thread cycles:u and instructions:u, one pinned group, no inheritance. Reset counts while disabled, retain cumulative enabled/running times before and after each window, require positive equal deltas for full scheduling coverage. Preserve all errors/raw values; no scaled counts.
time_policy: Thread CPU and wall are recorded separately. Hardware spans the timer calls. Empty windows are kept without subtraction. Cycles/CPU is not a calibrated frequency; reference cycles are unavailable.
controls_failure: Stop and retain the failure before samples if the control fails. Never edit an executed runner, driver or result.
analysis: Retain all 576 work and 576 empty windows. Produce six-pair comparisons only where every work and empty window in all six pairs is usable. Report every construction row and complete 32-phase matrix, including adverse and unavailable observations.
identity: All 32 exact witness/representation inventory rows must match the earlier unchanged trace in every process. Guard main source, all 35 pending native paths, previous source trees, artifacts, libraries and binaries.
limits: A different observation wrapper changes standalone machine code and measurement overhead. New timings cannot replace either prior timing-only trial.
Earlier-phase cache state, compiler decisions, layout, environment and interactions remain possible causes unless this diagnostic directly resolves them.
Current governor snapshots do not establish historical host settings; this protocol does not modify any host policy.
Descriptive six-pair comparisons are not statistical significance or evidence for admitting a runtime candidate.
